title: Gold Bar Reload Blueberry Ice Prefilled Vape Pods - 20mg
description: Blueberry Ice flavour Gold Bar Reload prefilled pods combine the sweet, nuanced taste of ripe blueberries with a refreshing, crisp icy finish. This delightful blend offers a cool vape experience that's reminiscent of enjoying a blueberry sorbet or a chilled blueberry drink on a sunny day. Each inhale brings a burst of sweet blueberry flavour, immediately followed by a cool exhale that refreshes and invigorates your taste buds. The Gold Bar Reload Pod Kit is designed for vapers seeking a convenient, compact device for premium vaping on the go. It mirrors the elegance and sophistication of the Gold Bar range, offering a reusable solution without the need to dispose of the whole device, thanks to its compatibility with Reload prefilled pods available in a selection of Gold Bar's most popular flavours. With these Gold Bar Reload prefilled pods, enjoy a variety of delightful flavours and a supremely satisfying MTL experience. Each pod's Hyper Mesh Coil technology ensures a smooth, flavourful vape with every draw. The prefilled design eliminates the fuss of refills and maintenance, simplifying vaping to just enjoying the experience. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg salt nicotine e-liquid, providing a smoother throat hit and faster absorption for quick satisfaction of nicotine cravings. With the Reload prefilled pods, the rechargeable Gold Bar Reload Pod Kit offers a more sustainable and flavourful alternative to disposable vapes, making it easy to switch flavours without waste.
